write_log_files.description: Write the error and stream log files; forced on by GOA (env LOGROTATE)

goaccess.description: GoAccess report (env GOA); applies after a container restart

locked.description: Fields set by environment variables (read only)

locked_by.description: The environment variable that sets each locked field (read only)

locked_reason.description: Fields locked by the environment variable of another setting (an indirect lock), with the reason: key-size (the key type follows ACME_KEY_SIZE), ocsp-stapling-off (Must-Staple is off because ACME_OCSP_STAPLING turns OCSP stapling off), must-staple (OCSP stapling is required by ACME_MUST_STAPLE), goaccess (GoAccess, turned on by GOA, reads the log files), goaccess-setting (GoAccess, turned on by the GoAccess report setting, reads the log files: not an env lock). Fields locked by their own variable are not listed.

applies.description: When a change of each field takes effect

restart_pending.description: Settings that apply after a container restart (applies restart) saved with another value than the container runs with: restart the container to apply them
